name: Toma Karaoke
description: Toma Karaoke is a popular noraebang in Honolulu offering private rooms equipped with modern sound systems that create a concert-like experience. The venue features a good selection of songs, including Japanese tracks, and provides a lively yet comfortable atmosphere. Staff are friendly and accommodating, allowing guests to bring their own food and drinks, making it ideal for celebrations or casual singing sessions. Open late, it caters to groups of all sizes with reasonable rates and excellent service.
